title: Perfect For All My Purses!
text: Perfect For All My Purses!. I have numerous nice purses that I want to protect when not using them. I was able to fit them all into the nice roomy pockets, even the larger bags. The smaller pockets on top are great for wallets. Both organizers fit easily over my closet door side by side. It will be so much easier picking out a purse when I’m on the run now!

product_metadata.title: ZOBER Purse Organizer For Closet - Over The Door Purse Organizer W/ 6 Pockets for Easy Purse Storage - Durable Metal Hooks - Purse Rack W/Clear Pockets - Java (1 Pack)
features: NO MORE CHAOS: No more digging through a pile of purses on the floor to find the one you want - with this purse storage organizer, you'll be able to see and access all of your purses easily!
TIP-TOP SHAPE: No more squished or crumpled purses! This purse hanger allows you to neatly store your purses in a way that helps maintain their shape and structure.
EASY IDENTIFICATION - The slots are crafted of clear plastic, granting you a perfect view of the contents, making it quick and easy to choose the perfect purse.
EASY INSTALLATION: Our purse organizer for closet can be easily hung over any door with no tools required. Just hang our organizer over any door and our strong metal hooks will do the rest.

DIMENSIONS - Our purse hanger measures 14” W x 64” H Slot Sizes - Large pockets (the bottom 4 slots) are 11.25 in. X 10 in. X 5 in. - the Smaller pockets (the top 2 slots) are 11.25 in. X 7 in. X 4 in. - 14” W x 64” H
